title: Forge Hub | Auto Generator, Auto Escape, ESP & More
features:
🛠 Notice 🛠

This script is currently in beta. Updates and changes are expected. If you encounter any bugs, have questions, or would like to suggest new features, we’d love to hear from you.

Join our Discord server for support, bug reports, previews, suggestions, and more!

Features:

* Auto Generator - Enabled, Auto Open, Auto Complete, Reaction Time, Teleport To Generator
* Auto Door Barricade - Enabled, Accuracy
* Auto Escape - Enabled, Method (Instant/Pathfind), Reaction Time
* Auto Kill All (Killer)
* Auto Battery Pickup - Enabled, Distance, Teleport To Battery
* Auto Fuse Box - Enabled, Teleport To Fuse Box
* Killer Alert - Enabled, Alert Distance, Cooldown, Leave Alert
* Generator ESP - Enabled, Color, Show Progress, Distance
* Battery ESP - Enabled, Color, Distance
* FuseBox ESP - Enabled, Color, Distance
* Trap ESP - Enabled, Color, Distance
* Survivor ESP - Enabled, Color, Show Health, Show Stamina, Distance
* Killer ESP - Enabled, Color, Distance
* Fullbright
* No Fog
* Noclip
* Infinite Stamina
* Anti AFK
* Anti Stun
* Anti Slow
* Anti Ragdoll
* Auto Sprint
* Enable Jump - JPower slider
* Speed Modifier - Enabled, Speed

Join our Discord server to see our supported games!
